:::{#exr-rank-product-practice}
#### Finding how large the rank of a matrix product can be

@thm-rank-product shows how large the [rank](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-rank) of a [matrix product](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-mult)
can be.
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \sbmat{1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0},
\qquad
\matr{B} = \sbmat{2 & 3 \\ 4 & 5}.
$$

Find the number that, by @thm-rank-product, $\rankf{\matr{A}\matr{B}}$ cannot exceed.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Find $\rankf{\matr{A}}$ first.

:::

:::
